database.add_hook.doc: $db->addHook(hook): a hook fixture ("Relationships", "Permissions", "Tenancy", {"$hook": "Log"|"Transform"|"Nested"|"Decorator"|"Queries", ...}); the library's hooks run inside the database

mask.reason: the server's backend process id differs between connections

database.on_error.doc: Mirror::onError with a callback logging each Mirror\Failure to db.log as {"mirror": <method>, "callback": <name>, "event", "error"}

database.add_filter.doc: Database::addFilter(name, ...) with a global filter fixture (`fixture`, default `name`): encrypt, encrypt_operator, subQueryProbe, operator_double_decode, joinedSeal; each call logged to db.log as {"filter", "call"}

db.open.doc: A Database (README: database, the core vocabulary): new Database(adapter, cache, codecs) with its own Authorization (roles, default ["any"]) and the hooks Relationships and Permissions (`hooks` names others: "Tenancy", hook fixtures), setDatabase(database ?? ${ns}), setSharedTables, setTenant, setTenantPerDocument, setNamespace(namespace ?? "compat"), setSchemaless(schemaless) and create() (unless create: false). The adapter is PostgreSQL (service database-postgres), or `driver` "mariadb"|"mysql", or `engine` "sqlite" (file /tmp/compat-fs/${ns}/<file ?? "database.sqlite">, setEmulateMySQL(emulate_mysql ?? false)) | "memory" | "mongo" (service database-mongo); `redis: true` a Redis adapter (service database-redis-adapter); `pool` ({size, unreachable, read, of}) a Pool over a Utopia\Pools\Pool of connections; `mirror` ({destination, filters: ["log"], cache}) a Mirror over this source and a PostgreSQL destination (service database-postgres-mirror); `adapter` (a handle) a peer on that database's adapter; `detached` a fresh adapter neither made current nor set up; `cache` "memory"|"none"|"unreachable"|"redis"|"redis-mirror"|"redis-shared" (-igbinary for igbinary entries); `filters`: codec fixtures. Registers the canonical global filter fixtures first. Returns a handle; the database becomes the current one (unless `adapter` or `detached`).

db.select.doc: Makes the database `db` (a handle) the current one; true

db.adapter.doc: $db->getAdapter()->{method}(...args): any public adapter method, named arguments as database.*

db.profiler.doc: A method of the database's Profiler (setProfiling(true) made it): {method, args}

db.add_format.doc: Structure::addFormat(name, ...) with a format fixture: priceRange, priceRangeNew, email, structureFormatProbe, testformat, updateAttributeIntegerOnly, storedRange, storedEnum

db.log.doc: The entries fixtures logged since the last db.log (listener events, filter calls, transformations), in order; clears them

db.sql.doc: A statement on the database's own connection, naming no schema but the database's: rows as lists of column => text

db.cache.doc: A method of the database's Cache (Utopia\Cache\Cache): method load|save|save_with_lease|get_generation|touch|list|purge, args by name (key, ttl, hash, data, generation). Saves report whether they stored

db.mirror.doc: A part of a Mirror database (from outside it): part source|destination, the Database it wraps as a handle (null without a destination)

db.redis.doc: A raw command (a list of strings) on the database of the Redis adapter (service database-redis-adapter), keys naming the case namespace only: corrupts state behind the adapter; null

scrub.reason: documents carry the time they were written ($createdAt, $updatedAt, _createdAt, ...); the e2e suite also writes datetimes a day around now. Within 50 hours of the runner clock they read <now>
ID::unique() makes ids from the clock and random bytes when a document has no $id
the e2e suite's 14 MB longtext.txt documents stay out of the case files: long strings compare by length and SHA-256
